newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.25 percent in higher trade boosted by the bonds and over-the-counter markets, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 470.56 points, down from 471.72 on Friday.

Total volume was 6.39 million dinars against 850,558 dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the bonds market was 4.25 million dinars and over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.92 million dinars.
Detergents firm SPCD fell 1.3 dinar to 33.7 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat slid 0.94 dinar to 15.06. Amen Bank was down 0.74 dinar to 30.1 dinars.
Investment fund Tuninvest -SICAF eased 0.6 dinar to 11.4 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.36 dinar to 31.5.
Banque de Tunisie was up 0.8 dinar to 75 dinars.
